labels.function_help_dwelling: Dwelling: a bed and a door, every bed under a roof. A home for as many people as it has beds.
labels.function_help_storehouse: Storehouse: two or more storage chests and a door under a roof. Each chest holds 40.
labels.function_help_workshop: Workshop: a workbench under a roof.
labels.function_help_shrine: Shrine: an altar near open sky or the sacred tree. Prayers there feed your Favour.
labels.function_help_shelter: Shelter: a hearth or a bed and at least 6 blocks of roofed floor. Cover for the night.
labels.function_help_hall: Hall: a table and two benches under a roof, with at least 12 blocks of roofed floor. Neighbours gather there and rest twice as fast.
labels.function_help_garden: Garden: four or more planters side by side. Bushes in planters ripen twice as fast and still bear in winter; people plant berries in empty planters.
labels.function_help_lantern: Lanterns: wolves will not walk into their light, people see far by them at night, and two in a settlement make it feel safe to newcomers.
